newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Bombs rock offices in Bhutto home province.
newsitem.headline: Bombs rock offices in Bhutto home province.

text.p: Two bombs rocked government offices in Nawabshah town in ousted prime minister Benazir Bhutto's home province of Sindh on Thursday, but only one person was slightly injured, the state APP news agency said.

It said the victim, a visitor to the town, was injured when the first bomb went off in front of the deputy commissioner's office while people were working inside the building and an adjacent treasury office.
There was another blast nearby as the local sub-divisional magistrate and police chief were examining the site of the first explosion, APP said. Both men were unhurt.
There was no immediate indication of the motive for the bombings, two days after President Farooq Leghari sacked Bhutto on disputed charges of corruption and misrule.
APP quoted the local bomb disposal squad as saying the devices appeared to be time bombs.
